title: The Kitchen of the Old Mill House Again
author: Cyrus Voss
blurb: Sebastian Sandoval, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
